description: A voltage-controlled switch that picks one channel out of a polyphonic cable and passes it on

inputs.text: Chooses which channel of IN is passed, with the voltage range set on the menu spread evenly over the channels and the nearest one taken
The polyphonic signal to choose from; the number of channels on the cable is the number of positions the selector has

outputs.text: 10V on the polyphonic channel currently chosen, and 0V on every other channel
A 1ms pulse at 10V on a channel, at the moment that channel becomes the chosen one
The chosen channel of IN, carried on the output channel of the same number with the rest at 0V

notes: The choice is made among the channels of the cable in IN, so a mono cable gives the selector only one position and nothing to switch between.
A UT-OX placed immediately to the right takes a second, separately chosen channel from the same polyphonic input, and further UT-OX modules can be chained on from there.
With a polyphonic cable in CV, each of its channels makes its own choice and the result appears on the output channel of the same number.
menu: Voltage Range: 0V - 10V, 0V - 5V, 0V - 1V, -10V - 10V, -5V - 5V, -2.5V - 2.5V, -1V - 1V — sets the span of CV that is spread across the channels; a new module starts at 0V - 10V
